cands.name: Demi Busatta
cands.bio: Republican, Florida House since November 2020. Former nonprofit development director; chief of staff to Sen. Anitere Flores. Florida State University graduate. Unopposed in 2026.
cands.local_ties: Born in Cape Coral (1990); Miami-Dade legislator. Residence not stated in source.

record.text: Sponsored a 2021 bill addressing coastal flooding risk in oceanfront communities, sent to the governor in April 2021.
